_help: Default alt text, caption, credit and focal point for each image in content/images (key = file name without extension). `focus` is a CSS object-position used when an image is cropped. `crop` trims the original permanently for every use, as fractions, e.g. { "top": 0.15 } removes the top 15%. Alt text should describe what is in the photo; never name children. Images credited 'Pexels' are stock photography — replace with the Foundation's own photos when available.
